title: Document
description: Portable policy source. Tenant identity, activation and revision live in the API envelope.

spec_version.description: Required, exact contract discriminator; never inferred from other fields.

policies.description: Named policies selected by explicit router bindings.

SpecVersion.description: Closed discriminator: unsupported contracts cannot silently become defaults.

oneOf.description: Initial independently versioned model-only policy contract.

Policy.description: Model selection without context transformations, agent execution or learning state.

tiers.description: Named generation targets. A target is a model and optional reasoning effort.

default_tier.description: Required fallback when no admitted classification matches.

classifier_digest.description: Exact classifier configuration digest; required when routes are nonempty.

tool_use_tier.description: Tool-safe fallback when a tool-bearing request selects an unsafe tier.

tool_safe_tiers.description: Tiers permitted for tool-bearing requests when a tool fallback is configured.

Target.description: A generation target. No field can request context rewriting or harness behavior.

model.description: Explicit model selector resolved inside the authorized routing source.

effort.description: Absence preserves the caller's reasoning-effort constraint.

ReasoningEffort.description:
Qualitative reasoning-effort levels understood by BitRouter's built-in
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini protocol adapters.

This is the cross-provider superset, not a claim that every model supports
every value. Exact provider/model routes advertise their supported subset
separately and policy-owned effort targets are validated against it before
dispatch.

oneOf.description: Disable reasoning where the selected model supports doing so.
Use the smallest non-zero reasoning setting exposed by the model.
Prefer low reasoning cost and latency.
Balance reasoning depth with cost and latency.
Prefer deeper reasoning over cost and latency.
Use the provider's extra-high reasoning setting.
Use the provider's maximum reasoning setting.
